title: Onboarding observability visuals: latency / cost / trace screenshot set
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Produce a curated set of observability dashboard screenshots (latency, cost-per-token breakdowns, and tracing waterfall/span views) for use across the Onboarding/Quickstart docs, product release notes, and in-console help cards. The asset set must include annotated variants for docs, redacted public versions (no PII or API keys), and light/dark theme versions sized for doc inline (800px wide), modal preview (1200px), and high-DPI (2x). Work includes: capturing stable dashboard states, coordinating with backend to pin recent timestamps, masking customer identifiers, adding short explanatory callouts for doc use, exporting PNG and high-quality WEBP, and uploading to the shared design assets folder with naming conventions.
acceptance_criteria: Three canonical screenshots exported for each view (latency summary, cost-per-token per-route, tracing waterfall) in light and dark themes
Annotated doc-ready PNGs with numbered callouts and short captions exported at 800px and 1200px widths plus 2x assets
Public/redacted versions where all customer identifiers, API keys, and raw tokens are blurred/removed
Figma source frames placed in onboarding observability file and linked from the docs PR/confluence
Design reviewed/approved by PM (Marco Ruiz) and signoff from Eng owner (Samir Kapoor) for redaction correctness
Files uploaded to Drive & linked in the ticket; small code snippet for embedding the in-console help card provided (HTML img + alt text)
